entries.zh: 喜；喜欢、喜悦（动词「喜爱／高兴」义）
entries.en: to like; to be pleased (with); to rejoice
entries.notes: R 栏残缺、M 栏声调污损，据 L「holgar」与 H「喜」及 R 内「hỳ hũa hỳ（喜欢）」互证释义。

entries.zh: 欣喜；欢喜；欣然喜悦
entries.en: to rejoice; to be glad

entries.zh: 乐；快乐、欢愉（此处取「喜悦」义，非音乐义）
entries.en: to delight (in); to take pleasure; joy
entries.notes: R 栏「ho」声调污损，据 H「樂」与 L「holgarse」释义。

entries.zh: 兴；兴致、高兴（另含「兴起、兴旺」义附后）
entries.en: to be in (high) spirits; to take delight; also, to rise, flourish

entries.zh: 游；游玩、游荡消遣
entries.en: to play; to ramble about; to amuse oneself idly

entries.zh: 欢喜；高兴、喜悦
entries.en: to rejoice; to be delighted

entries.zh: 游耍；玩耍、嬉游
entries.en: to play; to amuse oneself
entries.notes: R 栏音节存「hiu/ru」之疑且声调污损，据 H「遊耍」释义。

entries.zh: 游玩；嬉游作乐（次字存「玩/範」之疑，据 R 推定为「玩」）
entries.en: to play; to have fun; to sport
entries.notes: 汉字栏次字存「玩/範」之疑，依 R「rū guān」推定为「游玩」。

entries.zh: 游泳；泅水，游泳嬉乐（西语 holgarse 取「戏水为乐」义）
entries.en: to swim; to sport in the water; to take one's pleasure swimming
entries.notes: R 栏次音节声调污损，据 H「游泳」释义。

entries.zh: 尖耍；嬉耍作乐（首字义罕见待考）
entries.en: to play; to make sport (first element of compound uncertain)
entries.notes: 「尖耍」为罕见复合词且 R 栏声调污损，据次字「耍」与 L「holgarse」释义。

entries.zh: 散赏；散心赏玩、消遣作乐（首字存「範/散」之疑，释义存疑）
entries.en: to divert oneself; to take one's pleasure (first character uncertain: 範/散)
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字存疑且 R 栏声调污损，据 L「holgarse」与次字「賞」释义。

entries.zh: 靶标；箭靶、标的（首字存「艶/靶」之疑；或指射靶为戏，释义存疑）
entries.en: a target, mark (?); possibly target-shooting as sport — uncertain
entries.notes: 首字存疑，R「pà pio」音合「靶标」而其与 holgarse 之关联（射靶之戏）无法确证。

entries.zh: 标到极；张扬得意至极、趾高气扬（西语注 andar muy anchay＝衣饰华而气扬）
entries.en: to be exceedingly proud or flashy; to strut about in high style (andar muy ancho)
entries.notes: R 栏两处声调污损且混入西语重复，据 L「andar muy ancho」释为张扬得意。

entries.zh: 不胜欣喜；喜不自胜
entries.en: to rejoice exceedingly; to be overjoyed

entries.zh: 兴彩；欢畅高兴、兴高采烈（闽语惯用语）
entries.en: to be delighted; to be in good spirits
entries.notes: R 栏次音节声调污损，据 H「興彩」（闽语「欢畅」惯用语）释义。

entries.zh: 兴头；兴头正浓、兴致勃勃（首字存「興/具」之疑）
entries.en: to be in high spirits; elated, keen with excitement
entries.notes: 首字存疑且 R 栏声调污损，据 L「holgarse mucho」与 R「hêng」推定为「興頭」。

entries.zh: 性野；性情放恣、不受拘束（西语栏残缺）
entries.en: wild and unrestrained in disposition; to run wild in one's pleasures
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺（holgarse y g[残]ese…）且 R 栏声调污损，据 H「性野」释义。

entries.zh: 逍遥；自在闲游、无拘无束
entries.en: carefree and at ease; to idle about free of care

entries.zh: 逍遣；逍遥自遣、消遣闲游（次字存「遣/造」之疑，释义存疑）
entries.en: carefree diversion; to beguile the time idly (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏次字存「遣/造」之疑，据 L「holgarse sin cuidar」与首字「逍」释义。

entries.zh: 游耍；玩耍取乐
entries.en: to play; to amuse oneself without care
entries.notes: R 栏次音节声调污损，据 H「遊耍」释义。

entries.zh: 闲游；游荡闲逛、消闲取乐
entries.en: to ramble idly; to stroll about for pleasure
entries.notes: R 栏次音节声调污损，据 H「閒遊」释义。

entries.zh: 喜幸；欢喜庆幸、欣然自得
entries.en: joyful and fortunate; to rejoice in one's good fortune
entries.notes: R 栏次音节声调污损，据 H「喜幸」释义。
